title: Opposite post-processing orders of fermionic horizon channels and their quantum-resource monotonicity
summary: Relativistic quantum-information studies in noninertial and black-hole settings often determine resource behavior through explicit calculations for particular input states and state functionals, leaving unclear whether the recurring monotonic trends originate from those choices or from a common underlying structure.
